svg.title: ech-mailbox: peer messages wait in a mailbox, then join your next prompt or an hourly digest
svg.desc: A message from another Claude session reaches the receive hook. If its text starts with BLOCKING: it passes at once to the model. Otherwise it is held in the mailbox, which the status line counts. Your next typed prompt carries the held messages as context and empties the mailbox. Once an hour, a non-empty mailbox goes out as one digest turn. /mailbox lists the messages, /mailbox flush sends them now as one turn, /mailbox clear drops them. The plugin is off by default.
svg.text: your prompt, held messages as context

g.text: rectangle = session or hook, oval = model
Off by default: with enabled false the plugin registers no hook, and every message passes untouched.
